summary.text: Keven Stratton is a Republican member of the Utah State Senate for District 24, which covers parts of Utah and Wasatch counties, and was appointed to the seat on May 8, 2012. The Legislature's roster lists him as an attorney, businessman and farmer.

paragraphs.text: Stratton earned a B.S. in finance and a J.D. from Brigham Young University, according to the Utah Legislature's roster.
The roster lists his past service as chair and board member of the Provo/Orem Chamber of Commerce, a member of the Freedom Festival Committee and chair of Kids on the Move.
The roster lists his honors as Outstanding Businessman of the Year from the Utah State Chamber of Commerce and Outstanding Citizen of the Year.
